{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'

# Inspect the data
print(df.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(df.head())

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = df['status'].eq('refunded').sum()
completed_count = df['status'].eq('completed').sum()

print(f'\nNumber of refunded orders: {refunded_count}')
print(f'Number of completed orders: {completed_count}')

# Confirm total matches
assert completed_count + refunded_count == len(df), "Total count mismatch"

# Output the completed count
completed_count"}
